backend/main.mo: Main actor defining all data types (Listing, UserProfile, ChatThread, Notification, Review, etc.) and including mixins for storage and authorization with migration support.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module defining old and new actor state types with all data structures for upgrading canister state between versions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implemented features including analytics dashboard, CSV export, theme toggle, review system, and favoriting with associated files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend source files covering components, pages, API hooks, routing, auth, and feature modules.
frontend/docs/ic-ops-and-export.md: Documentation guide for managing deployed Internet Computer canisters including stopping, starting, and exporting code for local development.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark theme color tokens using OKLCH color space.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/api/actorClient.ts: Hook that provides access to the Internet Computer actor client and tracks its readiness state with performance timing and startup diagnostics logging.
frontend/src/api/aiAssist.ts: React Query hook to check if AI assist is enabled on the backend, with 5-minute cache and error handling.
frontend/src/api/chat.ts: Chat API hooks for threads and messages using React Query; returns empty data in dev-bypass mode and shows toast notifications when chat actions are attempted without real authentication.
frontend/src/api/insights.ts: React Query hook to fetch stubbed analytics data from the backend for insights dashboard.
frontend/src/api/listings.ts: Listings API hooks that switch between mock data (in dev-bypass/mock mode) and real backend calls for CRUD operations, search, and saved listings, with autosuggest cache clearing on mutations.
frontend/src/api/notifications.ts: React Query hooks for fetching notifications and marking them as read via the actor client.
frontend/src/api/profile.ts: User profile hooks with performance timing instrumentation; fetches caller profile with stub fallback and caches results, plus mutation for saving profile updates.
frontend/src/api/queries.ts: Centralized query key definitions for React Query, organized by domain (profile, listings, chat, notifications, insights, reviews).
frontend/src/api/reviews.ts: React Query hooks for fetching and adding seller/product reviews with automatic cache invalidation on mutations.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root app component providing theme, auth, routing, and toast notifications with startup performance timing, profile cache hydration, and theme preference application from cookies.
frontend/src/app/effects/CursorReactiveL: Disabled cursor glow effect component that renders an invisible canvas; skips rendering on touch devices or when reduced motion is preferred.
frontend/src/app/effects/useReducedMotio: Hook that detects user's prefers-reduced-motion media query preference and updates on changes.
frontend/src/app/guards/AuthModeGate.tsx: Auth guard component that redirects unauthenticated users from protected routes to login, with performance timing instrumentation; renders children non-blocking.
frontend/src/app/guards/DevOnlyRouteGate: Route guard that restricts access to development-only pages, redirecting to home in production builds.
frontend/src/app/guards/OnboardingGate.t: Guards protected routes by redirecting users to onboarding if their profile is incomplete, with loading state and dev-bypass support.
frontend/src/app/interactions/pullToRefr: Container component that displays a loading spinner during pull-to-refresh gesture with animated transform based on pull distance.
Touch-only hook that detects pull-down gestures at scroll top and triggers refresh callback when pull exceeds threshold, respecting reduced motion preferences.
frontend/src/app/layout/AppShell.tsx: Main layout wrapper that combines TopBar, main content area, and BottomTabs navigation with configurable title and actions.
frontend/src/app/layout/BottomTabs.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar with five tabs (Home, Search, Sell, Cart, Chats) including cart badge counter and active state persistence.
frontend/src/app/layout/TopBar.tsx: Sticky top header with back button, title, search, notifications, theme toggle, and user avatar dropdown menu with logout functionality.
frontend/src/app/modals/ConfirmDiscardMo: Reusable alert dialog for confirming discard of unsaved changes with customizable title and description.
frontend/src/app/router.tsx: TanStack Router configuration with eager-loaded critical pages, lazy-loaded secondary pages, and route guards for auth and onboarding.
frontend/src/app/routes.ts: Centralized route path constants and helper functions for parsing listing and chat thread IDs from URLs.
frontend/src/app/startup/PageSkeleton.ts: Loading placeholder component displaying skeleton grid for lazy-loaded pages with responsive columns.
frontend/src/app/startup/ProfileTimeoutF: Fallback UI card shown when profile loading exceeds timeout, offering retry or guest mode continuation options.
frontend/src/app/startup/useProfileStart: Hook that triggers timeout state after 2 seconds of profile loading with retry and guest mode continuation handlers.
frontend/src/features/ai/provider/aiProv: AI provider abstraction that enhances listing data with deterministic fallback when AI is disabled, preparing for future Chutes API integration.
frontend/src/features/analytics/componen: Displays three engagement metric cards (Saves, Cart Adds, Chat Initiations) with icons, values, and trend indicators using mock data based on the selected time range.
Renders a line chart showing sales trends over time using Recharts, with mock data generated based on the selected time range.
Provides a button group selector for choosing analytics time ranges (7, 30, or 90 days) with visual feedback for the active selection.
Displays a bar chart comparing total views and unique visitors over time using Recharts, with mock data generated based on the time range.
frontend/src/features/analytics/export/e: Exports analytics data to a CSV file including popular categories, traded categories, and top items with timestamp-based filename generation.
frontend/src/features/auth/AuthMode.ts: Configuration module for toggling between development mode (using dev identity and localStorage) and production mode (requiring Internet Identity authentication).
frontend/src/features/auth/components/Lo: Renders a login/logout button that handles authentication state changes and clears all cached data (profile, searches, filters, etc.) on logout.
Manages a localStorage flag for persisting dev/guest mode state across sessions, with enable/disable/check functions.
frontend/src/features/auth/devModeDefaul: Provides a hardcoded default user profile for development mode with pre-filled student information and verification status.
frontend/src/features/auth/hooks/useCurr: Re-exports the API hook for fetching the current authenticated user's profile.
frontend/src/features/auth/hooks/usePost: Hook that determines post-login navigation, redirecting to onboarding if profile is incomplete or to home if complete, with special handling for dev-bypass mode.
frontend/src/features/auth/plugin/AuthPr: React context provider that wraps an auth provider implementation (currently StubSupabaseAuthProvider) and manages session state, sign-in, and sign-out operations.
frontend/src/features/auth/plugin/authSt: Provides localStorage helpers for persisting and retrieving auth session data with validation and error handling.
frontend/src/features/auth/plugin/authTy: Defines TypeScript interfaces for the pluggable auth system including AuthSession, AuthProvider, and AuthContextValue types.
frontend/src/features/auth/plugin/provid: Bridge adapter that wraps Internet Identity authentication into the new pluggable auth provider interface.
Placeholder Supabase auth provider that supports dev-bypass email authentication and persists sessions to localStorage, throwing errors for real authentication attempts.
frontend/src/features/auth/plugin/useAut: React hook that provides access to the auth context, throwing an error if used outside of AuthProvider.
Utility functions for caching, retrieving, and clearing user profile data in localStorage with error handling.
frontend/src/features/cart/components/Ca: Displays a cart summary card showing cart items with images, prices, and remove buttons, with a scrollable list and total price calculation. Includes empty state and navigation to full cart view.
frontend/src/features/cart/hooks/useCart: Custom hook that manages cart state with localStorage persistence, providing methods to add, remove, clear items and check if items are in cart. Syncs cart state across browser tabs using storage events.
frontend/src/features/chat/components/Qu: Simple button component with a dollar sign icon that triggers insertion of a quick offer template into the chat input.
frontend/src/features/chat/components/Sm: Renders contextual smart reply suggestion chips based on chat messages and listing title, allowing users to quickly select pre-generated responses.
frontend/src/features/chat/components/Th: Displays a chat thread item with avatar, listing ID, last message preview, timestamp, and unread badge. Includes time-ago formatting helper function.
frontend/src/features/chat/readReceipts/: Helper function that determines if a 'Seen' read receipt should be shown for the last message in a chat thread based on sender and read status.
frontend/src/features/chat/smartReplies/: Generates contextual smart reply suggestions based on the last message content, detecting keywords like 'price', 'meet', or 'condition' to provide relevant quick responses.
frontend/src/features/chat/typing/useTyp: Hook that publishes typing status to the backend with 2-second debouncing, automatically clearing typing status after the debounce period.
frontend/src/features/checkout/checkoutS: Manages checkout data persistence in sessionStorage, storing seller groups and grand total for the checkout flow.
frontend/src/features/checkout/splitBySe: Groups cart listings by seller and calculates subtotals per seller, providing an extension point for future multi-seller payment routing and splitting.
frontend/src/features/comparison/compone: Fixed-position floating button that appears when 2+ items are selected for comparison, showing a badge with the count.
Checkbox component with backdrop blur styling positioned absolutely for selecting listings to compare, with disabled state support.
frontend/src/features/comparison/hooks/u: Manages comparison selection state with sessionStorage persistence, enforcing a maximum of 3 items and providing methods to add, remove, toggle, and clear selections.
frontend/src/features/discovery/componen: Displays a horizontal scrollable section of top 5 featured listings sorted by rating and transaction count, with a special 'Featured' badge overlay.
Renders a horizontal scrollable strip of recently viewed listings retrieved from localStorage, fetching full listing data from the backend.
Displays a horizontally scrollable section of recommended listings (items 6-12 from the listings API) with a Sparkles icon header and optimistic save/unsave functionality.
Renders personalized suggestions in a grid layout using heuristics based on saved listings and user signals, with staggered fade-in animations for each card.
Displays a horizontally scrollable section of trending listings (first 6 items from the listings API) with a TrendingUp icon header and optimistic save/unsave functionality.
frontend/src/features/discovery/feeds/fe: Provides deterministic feed computation functions that score and rank listings for Trending and Recommended feeds based on local signals like recently viewed items, searches, and saved listings.
frontend/src/features/discovery/suggesti: Generates personalized listing suggestions by scoring categories based on recently viewed, saved, and searched items, filtering out already-viewed/saved listings and returning top-scored active listings.
frontend/src/features/home/components/Da: Renders a 4-column grid of quick action cards (Sell, Search, Trending, Insights) with icons and hover effects that navigate to corresponding routes.
Displays a 3-column grid showing user stats (Saved items, Cart count, My Listings) as clickable cards that navigate to their respective pages.

Renders an "Explore" section with three widgets: Continue Browsing (recent views), Top Categories (category badges), and Marketplace Insights (listing count), all clickable to navigate to relevant pages.
frontend/src/features/home/components/Ma: Displays a scrolling marquee banner with announcements about CampusMarket features and safety tips, styled with a gradient background and megaphone icon.
frontend/src/features/home/components/Pe: Displays a personalized preview of up to 4 listings scored by recently viewed items, recent searches, and saved item categories, with skeleton loading states and staggered animations.
frontend/src/features/home/components/Sa: Renders a horizontal scrollable strip of saved listings with thumbnails, titles, and prices, hidden when empty or loading.
frontend/src/features/listings/aiAssist/: Shows AI-generated suggestions for title, description, and price based on current form data and wizard step, with apply buttons for each suggestion.
Contains logic to generate enhanced titles, descriptions, and price suggestions based on form data, condition, and category.
Provides a panel to generate and apply AI-enhanced title and description suggestions using the AI provider, with regenerate functionality.
frontend/src/features/listings/component: Displays active filter badges for categories, conditions, price ranges, and campus locations with individual remove buttons and a clear-all option.
Renders a styled badge for product condition with optional wear-level indicator dots based on condition type.
Displays a card showing the product condition badge and optional defect description with an alert icon.
A mobile-friendly bottom sheet component for filtering and sorting listings. Provides category selection, sort options, and a clear filters button.

A comprehensive filter sidebar component with accordions for categories, price ranges, product conditions, and campus locations (dorms, buildings, zones). Includes checkboxes, sliders, and a reset button to manage listing filters.

A card component displaying listing details including image, title, price, condition badge, seller rating, and action buttons for saving and adding to cart. Supports skeleton loading and featured highlighting.
A wrapper component for displaying listing images with error handling and lazy loading support. Handles both blob URLs and regular URLs.
A carousel component for displaying multiple listing images with navigation controls and pagination indicators. Shows a fallback message when no images are available.
Displays suggested campus meetup spots for safe exchanges in a card layout with icons. Shows a default message if no specific locations are provided.
frontend/src/features/listings/edit/Edit: A form component for editing existing listings with fields for title, description, price, condition, category, images, and meetup locations. Includes validation and submission handling.
frontend/src/features/listings/filters/f: Custom hook managing listing filter state including categories, price ranges, conditions, and campus locations. Provides toggle functions and active filter detection.
frontend/src/features/listings/filters/h: Provides a React hook for managing home feed filters (category, price range, sort) with URL sync, persistence, and listing filtering logic.
frontend/src/features/listings/filters/s: Defines sort options (relevance, price, newest, popularity, condition, distance) and implements sorting logic for listings including relevance scoring.
frontend/src/features/listings/hooks/use: Custom hook for toggling saved/unsaved state of a listing with optimistic UI updates and toast notifications.
frontend/src/features/listings/mock/mock: Contains an array of mock listing data with various products (electronics, textbooks, furniture, clothes) for development and testing.
In-memory mock client for listings API operations (CRUD, search, save/unsave) using mock data for development without backend.
Provides a hook to toggle mock mode in development only, with strict production enforcement that prevents mock mode activation.
frontend/src/features/listings/myListing: Card component displaying a user's own listing with status badge, image, price, and action buttons (view/edit).
frontend/src/features/listings/sellWizar: Exports a function that creates a partial SellWizardFormData object from an existing Listing, appending '(Copy)' to the title and copying all relevant fields.
Image upload component with drag-to-reorder, remove functionality, and support for multiple images with a configurable maximum limit.
Multi-step wizard form for creating/editing listings with progress tracking, validation, autosave, and step navigation.
Defines TypeScript types and constants for the sell wizard including form data structure, wizard steps (0-4), categories array, and image limits (1-5).
Provides validation functions for each wizard step (basic info, pricing, location, images) and a combined validator, returning ValidationErrors objects with field-specific error messages.
React component rendering the first wizard step with inputs for title, category, condition, and optional defect description, displaying validation errors inline.
React component for the images wizard step that wraps an ImagePicker component allowing users to add up to 5 photos with the first as cover image.
React component for selecting campus meetup locations using checkboxes organized by type (dorms, buildings, zones, meetup spots) with toggle functionality.
React component for the pricing wizard step with inputs for price, optional original price, and description with character count and validation error display.
React component displaying a read-only review of all entered data organized in cards with edit buttons to jump back to specific wizard steps.
Custom React hook that autosaves sell wizard form data to local storage every 4 seconds and provides functions to restore or clear the draft.
frontend/src/features/notifications/comp: React component rendering a clickable notification card with icon, title, description, timestamp, and unread indicator based on notification type.
frontend/src/features/recommendations/re: Defines recommendation types and provides a heuristic-based recommendation engine that computes trending, personalized, collaborative, and category-based listing suggestions without external API calls.
frontend/src/features/recommendations/us: React hook that fetches all listings and saved listings, then uses the recommendation provider to compute and return recommendations based on type, limit, and optional context listing.
frontend/src/features/reviews/components: Displays a single review with reviewer info, star rating, timestamp, and optional comment text in a card layout.
Renders a list of ReviewCard components or a placeholder message when no reviews exist.
Modal dialog for submitting a review with interactive star rating, optional comment textarea, and submission handling with loading states and validation.
frontend/src/features/saved/savedSorting: Applies category filtering and sorting to saved listings using centralized sort utilities.
frontend/src/features/saved/SavedToolbar: Toolbar component for filtering saved listings by category and sort option, with a clear button to reset filters.
frontend/src/features/search/autosuggest: Implements in-memory and sessionStorage caching for autosuggest results with 5-minute TTL and cache management functions.
Generates autosuggest suggestions by matching query against recent searches, listing titles, and categories, with caching support.
frontend/src/features/search/components/: Dropdown component displaying autosuggest results with keyboard navigation support (arrow keys, enter, escape).
Displays category chips with emojis for browsing, allowing single-selection toggle and notifying parent of category changes.
Mobile-optimized grid layout of category cards with icons, designed for touch interaction with active scale animations.
Horizontal scrollable navigation bar of category buttons with icons, highlighting the active category and supporting category selection.
Displays a panel of recent search terms with individual delete buttons and a clear-all option, using local state and persistence utilities.
Renders a filter bar with sort dropdown, active filter badges, and mobile filter button with badge count.
frontend/src/features/search/searchFilte: Provides client-side filtering and sorting logic for search results by category, price range, and sort order (relevance, newest, price).
A button component that toggles between light and dark themes using the useTheme hook.
frontend/src/features/theme/useTheme.ts: Custom hook that manages theme state (light/dark), applies it to the DOM, and persists preference to cookies.
frontend/src/features/trustSafety/badges: Displays UI-only badges (New Seller, Trusted, Fast Responder) based on boolean props.
Renders a 5-star rating display with numeric rating and optional transaction count.
Shows a checkmark icon with tooltip for verified students when the verified prop is true.
frontend/src/features/trustSafety/report: A bottom sheet modal for reporting listings with radio button reasons and submit/cancel actions.
Defines a fixed list of report reasons (spam, inappropriate, scam, duplicate, sold, other).
frontend/src/features/trustSafety/safety: Displays an alert banner with safety tips for meeting in public and protecting financial information.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, invalidating dependent queries on identity change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for login, logout, and identity state management using AuthClient.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system for light/dark themes, custom component styles, and motion-safe animation utilities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient, InternetIdentityProvider, and renders the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/CartPage.tsx: Shopping cart page displaying cart items with images, prices, and total; supports item removal, cart clearing, and navigation to checkout.
frontend/src/pages/ChatsInboxPage.tsx: Chat inbox page listing all chat threads with loading states, error handling, and navigation to individual thread pages.
frontend/src/pages/ChatThreadPage.tsx: Individual chat thread page showing messages between buyer and seller with real-time message sending, auto-scrolling, and authentication handling.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutConfirmationP: Order confirmation page displaying order summary, payment distribution across sellers, and clearing cart after successful checkout.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Checkout page grouping cart items by seller, showing payment split preview, and navigating to confirmation with stored checkout data.
frontend/src/pages/ComparisonPage.tsx: Product comparison page displaying up to 3 listings side-by-side with ability to remove items and exit comparison mode.
frontend/src/pages/DevQaChecklistPage.ts: Development-only QA checklist page that provides mock mode toggle and quick navigation links to test various app flows (home feed, listing details, saved items, chats, notifications) with different filters and states.
frontend/src/pages/EditListingPage.tsx: Page for editing an existing listing that fetches listing data by ID, renders an EditListingForm component, and handles submission with optimistic updates and navigation back to the listing detail page.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main discovery page displaying dashboard stats, quick actions, announcements, featured/trending/recommended sections, category navigation, personalized listings, recently viewed items, and a grid of all listings with pull-to-refresh support.
frontend/src/pages/InsightsPage.tsx: Analytics dashboard page showing marketplace insights with time-range filtering, engagement metrics cards, sales trends and view counts charts, category analytics, and CSV export functionality.
frontend/src/pages/ListingDetailsPage.ts: Detailed listing view page displaying image carousel, pricing, condition badges, seller info with verification/ratings, meetup locations, safety tips, and action buttons for save/cart/chat/share/report with recently-viewed tracking.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Authentication page with email input form that handles sign-in via the auth plugin, displays provider info alerts for placeholder auth, validates email format, and manages post-login redirects.
frontend/src/pages/MyListingsPage.tsx: Displays the current user's listings with authentication check, loading states, and empty state. Provides navigation to create new listings and shows listings in an animated grid.
frontend/src/pages/NotificationsPage.tsx: Shows user notifications with mark-as-read functionality and navigation to relevant pages based on notification type (messages, listings, system). Includes loading skeletons and empty state.
frontend/src/pages/OnboardingPage.tsx: Onboarding form for new users to set up their profile with campus, hostel, and department information. Saves profile data and redirects to home on completion.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Displays the current user's profile including avatar, campus info, trust score, reliability metrics, and settings like theme toggle. Shows loading skeleton and handles missing profile state.
frontend/src/pages/RecentlyViewedPage.ts: Shows listings the user recently viewed, stored in local persistence. Fetches listing details from backend and provides clear history functionality with empty state.
frontend/src/pages/SavedPage.tsx: Displays user's saved listings with sorting/filtering toolbar and optimistic save/unsave toggling. Includes empty state with call-to-action to browse listings.
frontend/src/pages/SearchPage.tsx: Main search page component with filtering, sorting, category navigation, and mobile filter sheet. Applies search query, category, price, condition, and campus location filters to listings with optimistic save toggling.
frontend/src/pages/SellWizardPage.tsx: Sell wizard page for creating new listings with form submission, draft autosave, duplicate listing support, and discard confirmation modal. Handles listing creation with validation and navigation.
frontend/src/pages/SplashPage.tsx: Initial splash screen that displays app branding for 1.5 seconds, then redirects authenticated users to their last visited tab or unauthenticated users to login.
frontend/src/README-frontend-structure.m: Documentation describing the React + TypeScript frontend architecture, including pluggable auth system with dev-bypass mode, state management (React Query, local/session storage), discovery/recommendations, cart system, search, and placeholder for Chutes AI integration.
frontend/src/store/authOffPersistence.ts: Backward compatibility re-export layer that delegates to new persistence modules for saved listings and recent searches functionality.
frontend/src/store/localStorage.ts: Versioned localStorage wrapper with prefixed keys, providing get/set/remove/clear operations with error handling and version migration support.
frontend/src/store/persistence/cart.ts: Cart persistence module managing up to 50 cart items with add/remove/clear operations and duplicate prevention by listing ID.
frontend/src/store/persistence/cookies.t: Cookie preferences simulation via localStorage for campus slug, dark mode preference, and UI motion level settings.
frontend/src/store/persistence/homeFilte: Home feed filter persistence for category, price range, and sort order with default values.
frontend/src/store/persistence/lastVisit: Persists and retrieves the last visited bottom navigation tab with validation against allowed routes.
frontend/src/store/persistence/recentlyV: Tracks up to 20 recently viewed listings with timestamps, deduplication, and recency-based ordering.
frontend/src/store/persistence/recentSea: Manages up to 10 recent search terms with add, per-item delete, and clear-all operations.
frontend/src/store/persistence/savedList: Manages saved listings for unauthenticated users with save/unsave/check/clear operations via localStorage.
frontend/src/store/persistence/sellDraft: Persists sell wizard form drafts to localStorage with get/set/clear operations for autosave support.
frontend/src/store/persistence/storageKe: Centralized versioned storage key constants for all persistence layers including auth, cookies, discovery, user actions, UI state, and drafts.
frontend/src/theme/theme.md: Design documentation defining CampusMarket's warm coral/amber color palette using OKLCH color space, typography scale, and dark mode specifications for a friendly marketplace aesthetic.
frontend/src/utils/perfTimings.ts: Performance timing utility with safe guards for console and performance APIs, providing start/end timing measurements and logging that gracefully degrades when APIs are unavailable.
frontend/src/utils/startupDiagnostics.ts: Production-safe startup diagnostics class that records and reports application initialization stages with timestamps and status indicators, silently failing if console is unavailable.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: URL parameter parsing utilities supporting both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence for maintaining state like admin tokens across navigation.
frontend/src/utils/userFacingError.ts: Error message converter that transforms technical errors (authorization, network, timeout) into user-friendly messages suitable for display in the UI.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining OKLCH-based color system, custom spacing, animations, and theme extensions including condition colors, shadows, and responsive container settings.
project_state.json: Project state tracking document for CampusMarket SRM Institute marketplace, listing implemented features (analytics, theme toggle, reviews, favorites, comparison tool) and chunk-based development strategy.
